t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. AKUI NAH ITUNG TAKSI KA', O TUHAN, TENANGAN KUI, IKA' ALUNG UH NYELUNG AKUI NAI JADI' JAM IKA' DAHIN NYEPIDA IKA'. KERAI NIH AKUI BARA LEMA KUI KATYAHA DAHIN KUASA KA', KETAH KUI DAHIN KAYA' KA'. USI'TE' KET ALENG HA BEH DENG SENG AK KATALAU LA'AN MEH UH TENANGAN BIH IKA'TUA, ALENG NYEKANG AKUI, ALENG TE' MURIP NYELIMAN.
